actions.action: Separate naming directions from wording variants
actions.mechanism: Group suggestions by their stated rationale and constraints addressed, not merely by similar spelling or sound.
actions.implementation: Add rationale and constraint fields. Allow multiple direction memberships; preserve immutable originals and privately recorded authorship through grouping and ungrouping.
actions.check: Submit two similar names with different rationales; verify both directions remain visible and each original remains recoverable.
actions.risk: Manual grouping can impose one person's interpretation; allow disputed memberships.

actions.action: Make rejections depend on versioned constraints
actions.mechanism: Attach each rejection to an explicit reason and constraint version so changed assumptions expose decisions needing reconsideration.
actions.implementation: Store rejection explanations and linked constraint versions. On constraint edits, mark affected rejections 'review needed' without automatically restoring or accepting names.
actions.check: Reject a name against a constraint, then revise that constraint; verify the rejection is flagged and its original explanation retained.
actions.risk: Frequent constraint edits may create excessive review notifications.

actions.action: Give late suggestions an anonymous first-review queue
actions.mechanism: Separate initial evaluation from social signals and previous discussion, giving every submission a review opportunity.
actions.implementation: Hide authors, reactions, and prior verdicts during first review. Allocate unseen suggestions by fewest completed reviews, breaking ties randomly; retain access-controlled private authorship.
actions.check: Add a late alternative; verify assignment, author masking, and rationale capture before existing discussion appears. Inspect ordering for popularity inputs.
actions.risk: Distinctive wording can still reveal authors; anonymity cannot be guaranteed.

actions.action: Show hard-constraint conflicts beside every name
actions.mechanism: Keep support and eligibility separate: popularity cannot erase an unresolved conflict with a declared hard constraint.
actions.implementation: Add a visible constraint matrix with meets, conflicts, and unknown states, each backed by a user explanation. Keep conflicting names visible; calculate no winner.
actions.check: Give a popular name a documented hard-constraint conflict; verify its warning persists despite support, with no automatic removal or selection.
actions.risk: Disputed interpretations require visible counterarguments rather than authoritative-looking status labels.
